variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: 'def' binds a global var. 'let' creates local, immutable bindings.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
(def i 1)
(def d 1.0)
(def b true)
(def s "Text")
(def kw :keyword)
(def sym 'symbol)
data_types.notes: Keywords are heavily used as fast identifiers/keys.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Uses prefix notation. Operators are just functions.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
(if (> a b) a b)

(cond
  (= x 1) "One"
  (< x 10) "Small"
  :else "Other")
conditionals.notes: 'if' takes condition, then, else. 'cond' replaces chained if-else.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: 'doseq' is for side effects. 'for' is a list comprehension yielding lazy sequences.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Usually avoids while loops in favor of recursion or sequence operations.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: 'defn' creates named functions. '#()' is a reader macro for anonymous functions.

arrays.title: Vectors (Arrays)
arrays.notes: Uses persistent vectors instead of arrays. Modifications return a new vector.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Persistent hash maps. Keywords act as functions to look themselves up in a map.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Standard Java try-catch-finally, adapted for Lisp syntax.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Clojure provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Clojure supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Clojure provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Clojure converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Clojure represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Clojure formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Clojure branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Clojure defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Clojure iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Clojure organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Clojure stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Clojure groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Clojure tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Clojure organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
